ownAdaptation: All classroom sample sizes, brush duration, scoring category, observation schedule, slow pot displacement bound and one-event/day protection limit are original proposed teaching choices. They are not published dose thresholds, guarantees of response/recovery or validated results. No drugs, injury, ion-channel inhibition or genetic methods from research are carried over.
